This can cause the menu to appear too big:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3c18e7a4-b698-4559-8cb9-6723469970f3)
Probably OptionButton should be responsible for setting the minimum width. Or maybe the height could shrink to minsize, while width staying as is.

> This can cause the menu to appear too big: ![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/405028471-3c18e7a4-b698-4559-8cb9-6723469970f3.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..a29_LYFldh25lgzqa1ESr1gqFXLnzeqg2qxxbI2gH6s) Probably OptionButton should be responsible for setting the minimum width. Or maybe the height could shrink to minsize, while width staying as is.

It makes sense, I choose option 2

The width can still not shrink properly 🙃
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1c65472c-28e0-4afa-9c11-0ccea986b647)
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/92c4e890-8da2-4421-949b-78c26af1d9d1)
The former is expected minimum size, while the latter is a menu that did not shrink from wider size. Here it does not look that bad, because of the right-aligned shortcuts, but without it there would be empty space.

> The width can still not shrink properly 🙃 ![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/405210017-1c65472c-28e0-4afa-9c11-0ccea986b647.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Ah6leI4ly524MO1RAc3ACi5yqjNYWVgJCLU8jSGNO0Y) ![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/405210053-92c4e890-8da2-4421-949b-78c26af1d9d1.png?jwt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..I--fo6Z3VLR_9hXqzpSNYu1L7yyDfOTxwjV-tJSgS3c) The former is expected minimum size, while the latter is a menu that did not shrink from wider size. Here it does not look that bad, because of the right-aligned shortcuts, but without it there would be empty space.

Oddly enough, in my case there is no difference in their widths
no pr:
![屏幕截图_20250121_205754](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/02886588-fffa-4dc9-8f51-d8c6175cd31c)

this pr:
![屏幕截图_20250121_210336](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/17c2d96b-b29e-4fc1-b338-6732359da184)

Both screenshots were taken with this PR.
You need to display wider content (by right-clicking a file) and then right-click empty space for narrower menu. It does not shrink until you open it second time.

Oops, I accidentally closed this PR, but I can submit another fix as a new PR.
